> **For incorrect doses or clinical concerns, use the Dose correction template instead.** This one is for technical/UX issues where the calculator output is wrong because the code or display is broken, not because the underlying clinical content needs updating.

## What happened

A clear description of the bug.

## What you expected

What you thought would happen instead.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Enter '...'
3. Click '...'
4. See error / wrong result / broken layout

## Screenshots

If a layout, rendering, or visual issue, screenshots are very helpful. Mobile-specific issues should include device and browser.

## Environment

- **Device:** desktop / phone / tablet
- **OS:** macOS 14 / iOS 17 / Windows 11 / Android 14 / etc.
- **Browser:** Safari / Chrome / Firefox + version
- **Self-hosted or infusionfox.com:** (which deployment)

## Console errors

If you have browser developer tools, copy any errors from the Console tab. Optional but speeds up diagnosis.

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant. If the bug only happens with specific input values, list them.
